data.name: Abbas
data.gender_notes: Abbas is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abbas is a strong Arabic name meaning 'stern', 'austere', or 'lion'. It is famously associated with Al-Abbas ibn Ali, known for his bravery in the Battle of Karbala. The name Abbas carries the meaning “Lion, Stern, Gritty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Abbas usually hope their child will grow to embody lion, stern, gritty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, fearlessness, and self-sacrifice. Abbas stands for unwavering faith and courageous leadership.
data.etymology: Abbas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion, Stern, Gritty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abbas total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: عباس
in_urdu.long_meaning: عباس ایک مشہور نام ہے جو عربی جڑ عَبَسَ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اپنے چہرے پر اداسی یا غصے کا اظہار کرتا ہے، یہ نام ابو الفضل کے نام سے بھی جانی جاتی ہے، جو شجاعت اور بہادری کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: अब्बास

data.cultural_impact: Abbas is a widely used and cherished name in the Islamic world, with historical and cultural significance. It is the name of the noble companion and brave martyr, Al-Abbas ibn Ali, who selflessly fought to protect the Imam Hussein's camp during the Battle of Karbala. This battle is a pivotal moment in Islamic history, and Al-Abbas' unwavering commitment and courage have become a source of inspiration and pride for Muslims.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Abbas carries deep spiritual significance, not only as a reminder of Al-Abbas ibn Ali's demonstration of loyalty and dedication, but also as a symbol of steadfastness and bravery in the face of adversity. It represents the spiritual qualities that every believer aims to cultivate within themselves, including courage, selflessness, and fortitude. Wearing this name serves as an inspiring reminder of our spiritual goals and the importance of remaining steadfast in our faith and purpose.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Abbas is the name of the uncle of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and an essential companion in his early years. The name Abbas means 'the father of a lion' in Arabic, symbolizing his courage and unwavering support towards Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Abbas ibn Ali was the youngest brother of Imam Hussein and a companion of his during the Battle of Karbala in 680 AD.
